Article 3

The objectives of the implementation of protection of women and children are to: a. prevent the occurrence of violence against women and children; b. accompany women and children victims of violence in the legal process both litigation and non-litigation in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations;

c. provide a sense of security to women and children victims of violence; and

d. restore the physical and psychological condition of women and children victims of violence.

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:

1. Region is Manggarai Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Manggarai Regency. 3. Regent is the Regent of Manggarai.
4. Implementation of Protection of women and children is the process, method, act of implementing protection of women and children. 5. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
6. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
7. Violence is any form of act that results in or may result in misery or physical, emotional/psychological, economic, sexual and social suffering to the victim.
8. Violence against women is any act based on gender difference that results in or is likely to result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.
9. Violence against children is any form of act that results in or is likely to result in suffering to children physically, psychologically, socially, psychosocially, and sexually.
10. Victims are women including Female Workers and children who experience misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of such violence.
11. Protection of women is any act aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Article 9

(1) Regional apparatus that carry out the functions of empowerment and protection of women and children shall conduct monitoring to ensure synergy, continuity and effectiveness of integrated measures and the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(3) Monitoring shall be conducted periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of institutions/work units that implement policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence.

Article 8

(1) The Regional Government in the implementation of protection for Victims of Violence may involve community participation.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by individuals, groups or social community organizations.

(3) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (2) may be carried out in the form of:

a. preventing acts of violence against Women and Children; b. submitting reports to the authorities if acts of violence against Women and Children occur; and
c. providing assistance to victims.

Article 6

(1) The Regional Government is tasked with carrying out prevention, handling and recovery efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, by:

a. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; b. providing education on anti-violence values towards women and children;
c. collecting data and information on Women and Children Victims of Violence; and
d. conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection for Women and Children victims of violence.
(2) The Regional Government is obliged to carry out prevention, handling, recovery and rehabilitation efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, providing and organizing services for victims in the form of:
a. providing and facilitating the establishment of integrated services for victims by involving institutions and community elements;
b. encouraging public awareness of the importance of protection for victims; and
c. conducting community empowerment for the prevention of acts of violence.
(3) Further provisions regarding the duties of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (1) and the obligations of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

d. performance.
(3) Submission of reports as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be conducted at least once every 3 (three) months.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 6

(1) The Regional Government is tasked with carrying out prevention, handling and recovery efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, by:

a. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; b. providing education on anti-violence values towards women and children;
c. collecting data and information on Women and Children Victims of Violence; and
d. conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection for Women and Children victims of violence.
(2) The Regional Government is obliged to carry out prevention, handling, recovery and rehabilitation efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, providing and organizing services for victims in the form of:
a. providing and facilitating the establishment of integrated services for victims by involving institutions and community elements;
b. encouraging public awareness of the importance of protection for victims; and
c. conducting community empowerment for the prevention of acts of violence.
(3) Further provisions regarding the duties of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (1) and the obligations of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

10. Victims are women including Female Workers and children who experience misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of such violence.
11. Protection of women is any act aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Article 3

The objectives of the implementation of protection of women and children are to: a. prevent the occurrence of violence against women and children; b. accompany women and children victims of violence in the legal process both litigation and non-litigation in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations;

c. provide a sense of security to women and children victims of violence; and

d. restore the physical and psychological condition of women and children victims of violence.

Article 14

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:

1. Region is Manggarai Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Manggarai Regency. 3. Regent is the Regent of Manggarai.
4. Implementation of Protection of women and children is the process, method, act of implementing protection of women and children. 5. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
6. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
7. Violence is any form of act that results in or may result in misery or physical, emotional/psychological, economic, sexual and social suffering to the victim.
8. Violence against women is any act based on gender difference that results in or is likely to result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.
9. Violence against children is any form of act that results in or is likely to result in suffering to children physically, psychologically, socially, psychosocially, and sexually.
10. Victims are women including Female Workers and children who experience misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of such violence.
11. Protection of women is any act aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 9

(1) Regional apparatus that carry out the functions of empowerment and protection of women and children shall conduct monitoring to ensure synergy, continuity and effectiveness of integrated measures and the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(3) Monitoring shall be conducted periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of institutions/work units that implement policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence.

Article 8

(1) The Regional Government in the implementation of protection for Victims of Violence may involve community participation.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by individuals, groups or social community organizations.

(3) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (2) may be carried out in the form of:

a. preventing acts of violence against Women and Children; b. submitting reports to the authorities if acts of violence against Women and Children occur; and
c. providing assistance to victims.

Article 3

The objectives of the implementation of protection of women and children are to: a. prevent the occurrence of violence against women and children; b. accompany women and children victims of violence in the legal process both litigation and non-litigation in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations;

c. provide a sense of security to women and children victims of violence; and

d. restore the physical and psychological condition of women and children victims of violence.

Article 13

In the event that the Integrated Service Center has not been established based on this Regional Regulation as referred to in Article 7 paragraph (1), then the duties and obligations of the Integrated Service Center shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus that carries out the functions of empowerment and protection of women and children.

Article 5

Letter a

What is meant by protection and assistance is that every victim has the right to receive protection at the local level (regional) due to their status as a local community member, national protection due to their status as a citizen or resident, and international protection due to their status as a human being, a member of the world community (Human Rights).

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:

1. Region is Manggarai Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Manggarai Regency. 3. Regent is the Regent of Manggarai.
4. Implementation of Protection of women and children is the process, method, act of implementing protection of women and children. 5. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
6. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
7. Violence is any form of act that results in or may result in misery or physical, emotional/psychological, economic, sexual and social suffering to the victim.
8. Violence against women is any act based on gender difference that results in or is likely to result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.
9. Violence against children is any form of act that results in or is likely to result in suffering to children physically, psychologically, socially, psychosocially, and sexually.
10. Victims are women including Female Workers and children who experience misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of such violence.
11. Protection of women is any act aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Article 6

(1) The Regional Government is tasked with carrying out prevention, handling and recovery efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, by:

a. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; b. providing education on anti-violence values towards women and children;
c. collecting data and information on Women and Children Victims of Violence; and
d. conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection for Women and Children victims of violence.
(2) The Regional Government is obliged to carry out prevention, handling, recovery and rehabilitation efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, providing and organizing services for victims in the form of:
a. providing and facilitating the establishment of integrated services for victims by involving institutions and community elements;
b. encouraging public awareness of the importance of protection for victims; and
c. conducting community empowerment for the prevention of acts of violence.

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 9

(1) Regional apparatus that carry out the functions of empowerment and protection of women and children shall conduct monitoring to ensure synergy, continuity and effectiveness of integrated measures and the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(3) Monitoring shall be conducted periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of institutions/work units that implement policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence.

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

Article 6

(1) The Regional Government is tasked with carrying out prevention, handling and recovery efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, by:

a. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; b. providing education on anti-violence values towards women and children;

c. provide a sense of security to women and children victims of violence; and

d. restore the physical and psychological condition of women and children victims of violence.

Article 8

(1) The Regional Government in the implementation of protection for Victims of Violence may involve community participation.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by individuals, groups or social community organizations.

(3) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (2) may be carried out in the form of:

a. preventing acts of violence against Women and Children; b. submitting reports to the authorities if acts of violence against Women and Children occur; and
c. providing assistance to victims.

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:

1. Region is Manggarai Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Manggarai Regency. 3. Regent is the Regent of Manggarai.
4. Implementation of Protection of women and children is the process, method, act of implementing protection of women and children. 5. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
6. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
7. Violence is any form of act that results in or may result in misery or physical, emotional/psychological, economic, sexual and social suffering to the victim.
8. Violence against women is any act based on gender difference that results in or is likely to result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.
9. Violence against children is any form of act that results in or is likely to result in suffering to children physically, psychologically, socially, psychosocially, and sexually.
10. Victims are women including Female Workers and children who experience misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of such violence.
11. Protection of women is any act aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Article 9

(1) Regional apparatus that carry out the functions of empowerment and protection of women and children shall conduct monitoring to ensure synergy, continuity and effectiveness of integrated measures and the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(3) Monitoring shall be conducted periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of institutions/work units that implement policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence.

Article 14

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 8

(1) The Regional Government in the implementation of protection for Victims of Violence may involve community participation.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by individuals, groups or social community organizations.

(3) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (2) may be carried out in the form of:

a. preventing acts of violence against Women and Children; b. submitting reports to the authorities if acts of violence against Women and Children occur; and
c. providing assistance to victims.

Article 6

(1) The Regional Government is tasked with carrying out prevention, handling and recovery efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, by:

a. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; b. providing education on anti-violence values towards women and children;
c. collecting data and information on Women and Children Victims of Violence; and
d. conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection for Women and Children victims of violence.
(2) The Regional Government is obliged to carry out prevention, handling, recovery and rehabilitation efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, providing and organizing services for victims in the form of:
a. providing and facilitating the establishment of integrated services for victims by involving institutions and community elements;
b. encouraging public awareness of the importance of protection for victims; and
c. conducting community empowerment for the prevention of acts of violence.
(3) Further provisions regarding the duties of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (1) and the obligations of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:

1. Region is Manggarai Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Manggarai Regency. 3. Regent is the Regent of Manggarai.
4. Implementation of Protection of women and children is the process, method, act of implementing protection of women and children. 5. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
6. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
7. Violence is any form of act that results in or may result in misery or physical, emotional/psychological, economic, sexual and social suffering to the victim.
8. Violence against women is any act based on gender difference that results in or is likely to result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.
9. Violence against children is any form of act that results in or is likely to result in suffering to children physically, psychologically, socially, psychosocially, and sexually.
10. Victims are women including Female Workers and children who experience misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of such violence.
11. Protection of women is any act aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 3

The objectives of the implementation of protection of women and children are to: a. prevent the occurrence of violence against women and children; b. accompany women and children victims of violence in the legal process both litigation and non-litigation in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations;

c. provide a sense of security to women and children victims of violence; and

d. restore the physical and psychological condition of women and children victims of violence.

Article 8

(1) The Regional Government in the implementation of protection for Victims of Violence may involve community participation.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by individuals, groups or social community organizations.

(3) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (2) may be carried out in the form of:

a. preventing acts of violence against Women and Children; b. submitting reports to the authorities if acts of violence against Women and Children occur; and
c. providing assistance to victims.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:

1. Region is Manggarai Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Manggarai Regency. 3. Regent is the Regent of Manggarai.
4. Implementation of Protection of women and children is the process, method, act of implementing protection of women and children. 5. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
6. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
7. Violence is any form of act that results in or may result in misery or physical, emotional/psychological, economic, sexual and social suffering to the victim.
8. Violence against women is any act based on gender difference that results in or is likely to result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.
9. Violence against children is any form of act that results in or is likely to result in suffering to children physically, psychologically, socially, psychosocially, and sexually.
10. Victims are women including Female Workers and children who experience misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of such violence.
11. Protection of women is any act aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

Article 1

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

a. preventing acts of violence against Women and Children; b. submitting reports to the authorities if acts of violence against Women and Children occur; and
c. providing assistance to victims.

Article 9

(1) Regional apparatus that carry out the functions of empowerment and protection of women and children shall conduct monitoring to ensure synergy, continuity and effectiveness of integrated measures and the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(3) Monitoring shall be conducted periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of institutions/work units that implement policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence.

CHAPTER VI

ORGANIZERS OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:

1. Region is Manggarai Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Manggarai Regency. 3. Regent is the Regent of Manggarai.
4. Implementation of Protection of women and children is the process, method, act of implementing protection of women and children. 5. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
6. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
7. Violence is any form of act that results in or may result in misery or physical, emotional/psychological, economic, sexual and social suffering to the victim.
8. Violence against women is any act based on gender difference that results in or is likely to result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.
9. Violence against children is any form of act that results in or is likely to result in suffering to children physically, psychologically, socially, psychosocially, and sexually.
10. Victims are women including Female Workers and children who experience misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of such violence.
11. Protection of women is any act aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Article 3

The objectives of the implementation of protection of women and children are to: a. prevent the occurrence of violence against women and children; b. accompany women and children victims of violence in the legal process both litigation and non-litigation in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations;

c. provide a sense of security to women and children victims of violence; and

d. restore the physical and psychological condition of women and children victims of violence.

Article 12

Funding for the implementation of protection for women and children is sourced from:

a. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget; and/or
b. other lawful and non-binding sources of financing.

Article 10

(1) Evaluation of the implementation and policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children shall be conducted at the end of every fiscal year or when necessary according to needs.

(2) The results of the evaluation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children shall be used as input for the formulation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children for the following year.

(3) Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 14

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by placement in the Regional Gazette.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

Article 6

(1) The Regional Government is tasked with carrying out prevention, handling and recovery efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, by:

a. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; b. providing education on anti-violence values towards women and children;
c. collecting data and information on Women and Children Victims of Violence; and
d. conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection for Women and Children victims of violence.

a. providing and facilitating the establishment of integrated services for victims by involving institutions and community elements;
b. encouraging public awareness of the importance of protection for victims; and
c. conducting community empowerment for the prevention of acts of violence.

Article 11

(1) The Integrated Service Center shall report in writing the implementation of the protection of Women and Children victims of violence to the Regent.

(2) The report as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:

a. administration;
b. finance;
c. services; and
d. performance.
(3) Submission of reports as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be conducted at least once every 3 (three) months.

Article 13

(1) The Regional Government in the implementation of protection for Victims of Violence may involve community participation.

c. providing assistance to victims.

NUMBER 10 OF 2018

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

CHAPTER X

TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS

Article 10

(1) Evaluation of the implementation and policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children shall be conducted at the end of every fiscal year or when necessary according to needs.

(2) The results of the evaluation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children shall be used as input for the formulation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children for the following year.

(3) Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 9

(1) Regional apparatus that carry out the functions of empowerment and protection of women and children shall conduct monitoring to ensure synergy, continuity and effectiveness of integrated measures and the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence.

(3) Monitoring shall be conducted periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of institutions/work units that implement policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children victims of violence.

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:

1. Region is Manggarai Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Manggarai Regency. 3. Regent is the Regent of Manggarai.
4. Implementation of Protection of women and children is the process, method, act of implementing protection of women and children. 5. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
6. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
7. Violence is any form of act that results in or may result in misery or physical, emotional/psychological, economic, sexual and social suffering to the victim.
8. Violence against women is any act based on gender difference that results in or is likely to result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.
9. Violence against children is any form of act that results in or is likely to result in suffering to children physically, psychologically, socially, psychosocially, and sexually.
10. Victims are women including Female Workers and children who experience misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of such violence.
11. Protection of women is any act aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Article 3

The objectives of the implementation of protection of women and children are to: a. prevent the occurrence of violence against women and children; b. accompany women and children victims of violence in the legal process both litigation and non-litigation in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations;

c. provide a sense of security to women and children victims of violence; and

d. restore the physical and psychological condition of women and children victims of violence.

Article 6

(1) The Regional Government is tasked with carrying out prevention, handling and recovery efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, by:

a. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; b. providing education on anti-violence values towards women and children;
c. collecting data and information on Women and Children Victims of Violence; and
d. conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection for Women and Children victims of violence.
(2) The Regional Government is obliged to carry out prevention, handling, recovery and rehabilitation efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, providing and organizing services for victims in the form of:
a. providing and facilitating the establishment of integrated services for victims by involving institutions and community elements;
b. encouraging public awareness of the importance of protection for victims; and
c. conducting community empowerment for the prevention of acts of violence.
(3) Further provisions regarding the duties of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (1) and the obligations of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

Article 14

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this Regional Regulation is ordered by placement in the Regional Gazette.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 6

(1) The Regional Government is tasked with carrying out prevention, handling and recovery efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, by:

a. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; b. providing education on anti-violence values towards women and children;
c. collecting data and information on Women and Children Victims of Violence; and
d. conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection for Women and Children victims of violence.
(2) The Regional Government is obliged to carry out prevention, handling, recovery and rehabilitation efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, providing and organizing services for victims in the form of:
a. providing and facilitating the establishment of integrated services for victims by involving institutions and community elements;
b. encouraging public awareness of the importance of protection for victims; and
c. conducting community empowerment for the prevention of acts of violence.
(3) Further provisions regarding the duties of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (1) and the obligations of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:

1. Region is Manggarai Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Manggarai Regency. 3. Regent is the Regent of Manggarai.
4. Implementation of Protection of women and children is the process, method, act of implementing protection of women and children. 5. Women are human beings of female sex and persons recognized by law as women.
6. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
7. Violence is any form of act that results in or may result in misery or physical, emotional/psychological, economic, sexual and social suffering to the victim.
8. Violence against women is any act based on gender difference that results in or is likely to result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.
9. Violence against children is any form of act that results in or is likely to result in suffering to children physically, psychologically, socially, psychosocially, and sexually.
10. Victims are women including Female Workers and children who experience misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of such violence.
11. Protection of women is any act aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
12. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Article 11

(1) The Integrated Service Center shall report in writing the implementation of the protection of Women and Children victims of violence to the Regent.

(2) The report as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:

a. administration;
b. finance;
c. services; and
d. performance.
(3) Submission of reports as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be conducted at least once every 3 (three) months.

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 6

(1) The Regional Government is tasked with carrying out prevention, handling and recovery efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, by:

a. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; b. providing education on anti-violence values towards women and children;
c. collecting data and information on Women and Children Victims of Violence; and
d. conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection for Women and Children victims of violence.
(2) The Regional Government is obliged to carry out prevention, handling, recovery and rehabilitation efforts for victims of violence against Women and Children, providing and organizing services for victims in the form of:
a. providing and facilitating the establishment of integrated services for victims by involving institutions and community elements;
b. encouraging public awareness of the importance of protection for victims; and
c. conducting community empowerment for the prevention of acts of violence.
(3) Further provisions regarding the duties of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (1) and the obligations of the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Efforts to implement protection for women and children must continue to be carried out and their implementation should be conducted in a coordinated and integrated manner among relevant agencies and/or bodies. To support the smooth implementation of the protection for women and children in Manggarai Regency, a regional regulation regulating the protection of women and children is necessary.

In order to support such implementation, it is necessary to regulate the mechanisms and cooperation starting from the recovery of victims' physical and/or psychological condition, by determining the respective duties and functions and the obligations and responsibilities of health workers, spiritual counselors and accompanying volunteers. To further enhance the effectiveness of integrated services, this regional regulation establishes a mechanism that will coordinate among service officers, while simultaneously formulating program plans for improving efforts to implement protection for women and children.

Cooperation in the implementation of protection for women and children is directed at the prevention, handling and recovery of the victims' condition to their original state, both physically and psychologically, within a reasonable time, so that victims can carry out their daily activities and live in the community as before. Therefore, services must be implemented as maximally as possible immediately after a complaint or report from the victim to obtain services for the recovery of the condition of women and children victims of violence. In addition, preventive efforts to eliminate violence are also continuously carried out in various ways, so that violence against women and children in the long term can be eliminated or at least reduced in number.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

CHAPTER VIII

MONITORING, EVALUATION AND REPORTING

CHAPTER VI

ORGANIZERS OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

Article 8

(1) The Regional Government in the implementation of protection for Victims of Violence may involve community participation.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by individuals, groups or social community organizations.

(3) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (2) may be carried out in the form of:

a. preventing acts of violence against Women and Children; b. submitting reports to the authorities if acts of violence against Women and Children occur; and
c. providing assistance to victims.
